## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

Example: Full-page capture cuts off the bottom of a long docs page; sticky header overlaps the captured content.

## To Reproduce
1. Open the page (example: a long Notion / Google Docs page with a sticky nav)
2. Click Whole Scroll → Capture full page
3. Check the saved image / OCR result

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

Example: The full page is captured without crop, and sticky headers don’t overlap the content.

## Environment
- Browser / extension version: e.g. Chrome 130 / Whole Scroll 1.x
- OS: e.g. Windows 11 / macOS 15
- Page URL (if relevant):

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots of the page and the capture result.

## Additional context
Anything else that helps (sticky headers, OCR wrong text, crash, etc.).
